name: zeffect_handle_top_message_event
description: zEffect::HandleTopMessageEvent pushes a top HUD message for non-negative text-id event indices, using the text-id entry key when no localized message id is present.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this handler remains part of the broader zEffect animation event-dispatch tier S pass.

The smoke covers the negative-index skip and messageId==0 fallback-key push path. Nonzero message ids share the same push call after zLoc::GetMessageString, whose lookup behavior is covered by zLoc functional targets.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45cbc0 validates returning 2, skipping only negative textIdIndex values, loading g_zEffectAnim_TextIdEntryList[textIdIndex].messageId, calling zLoc::GetMessageString only for nonzero message ids, and always calling HudUi::PushTopMessageLine with duration 3.0 for non-negative indices.
The native smoke verifies the negative-index no-op path and the messageId==0 fallback message-key path through the real global top-message stack wrapper.
